description: Chunked retrieval index for LLM RAG over the consolidated owner's manual

chunks.title: Vessel identity
chunks.text:
2023 BENETEAU Flyer 8 SPACEdeck HIN BEYFT208F223 EU CIN FR-SPBFT208F223.
Built ~June 2022 (HIN F2). US-market Beneteau America Marion SC with USCG and EPA EVAP plates.
CE Cat C/D, 10 persons, max load 1285 kg, notified body 0607. Builder SPBI France.

chunks.title: Engine identity
chunks.text:
Mercury Verado 300 V8 AMS model 13000069A designation 300XXL ESN 3B371488.
300 HP / 221 kW, 30 inch XXL shaft, Cold Fusion White, DTS controls, SmartCraft PCM 112.

chunks.title: EPHS steering pump
chunks.text:
Steering is Mercury EPHS MPU part 8M6005909 series TRW10 id A0071925 built 2021-08-30.
Electro-hydraulic assist (not pure steer-by-wire). Check reservoir MIN-MAX; owner photo near MIN.
Use only Mercury-specified synthetic power steering fluid.

chunks.title: Blue Sea fuse box
Peripheral DC feeds
Main fuse box amps
chunks.text:
Main fuse box diagram slots: I 5A, II 3A, III 10A, IV 15A, V 15A, VI 5A, VII 20A, VIII 15A, IX 5A, X 3A, XI empty, XII empty.
Use physical onboard legend as final authority when replacing fuses.

chunks.title: Shore power AC
chunks.text:
115V/60Hz shore panel with Schneider iDPN N Vigi C32 30mA RCD, ABB S202C C16 breakers, Schneider iIL indicator.
Charger CRISTEC YPOWER YPO12-25DE S/N 2022061017878 output 12V/25A input 90-265VAC.
Profile sticker OPENED TYPE FREE ELECTROLYTE — verify vs actual batteries. Not Mastervolt.

chunks.title: Battery banks
chunks.text:
Two yellow IMNASA boxes labeled ENGINE BATTERY and HOUSE BATTERY in locker under teak hatch.
Chemistry unverified. Mercury Verado typically wants AGM start battery — reconcile with CRISTEC flooded profile sticker.

chunks.title: Power-up sequence summary
chunks.text:
Power-up: disconnect shore if leaving; ENGINE+HOUSE switches ON; lanyard on; DTS NEUTRAL; ignition ON wait SmartCraft/VesselView;
START; verify tell-tale, no alarms, steering assist, Zipwake/Garmin up. Full steps in chapters/05-power-sequences.md.

chunks.title: Power-down sequence summary
chunks.text:
Power-down: neutral idle; STOP; ignition off; remove lanyard; electronics off; bilge check; salt flush engine; battery switches off
unless dedicated bilge must stay live (verify switch design). Shore optional for CRISTEC charge.

chunks.title: Shore connect order
chunks.text:
Connect: engine off; cord to boat inlet first; pedestal last; confirm indicator/RCD; CRISTEC ON LED.
Disconnect: pedestal first then inlet. Never bypass 30mA RCD.

chunks.title: Helm equipment
chunks.text:
Helm confirmed: Garmin GPSMAP 7x3/9x3/12x3 family (QSM cover CONFIRMED; exact size TBD), Mercury VesselView 403, Fusion MS-RA70N (N2K),
Mercury DTS single lever (TRANSFER / THROTTLE ONLY; DOCK vs ACTIVE TRIM / QUICK STEER TBD) + red lanyard,
SmartCraft DTS Quick Reference Guide cover onboard (Single Handle ERC 90-8M0208789),
Zipwake AUTO PITCH/AUTO ROLL + rotary, Sleipner thruster panel+joystick,
offshore compass. No fixed VHF. LENCO not installed. MS-RA210 not installed. ECHOMAP not installed.

chunks.title: Garmin GPSMAP x3
chunks.text: Garmin GPSMAP 7x3/9x3/12x3 family CONFIRMED via onboard Quick Start Manual cover. Not ECHOMAP UHD/UHD2. Exact 7/9/12 inch SKU and xsv sonar variant still need About/bezel photo. Prefer GPSMAP x3 Owner's Manual; Blue Sea HDS 5A feeds the display.

chunks.title: VesselView 403
chunks.text: Mercury VesselView 403 CONFIRMED via onboard installation sheet (AUGUST 2017 / 90-8M0124488 family). Non-touch 5-button SmartCraft engine display — not a chartplotter. Prefer VV403 Operation Manual 90-8M0124182 and Quick Guide for screens, setup wizard, alarms, and USB software update. 502/704 manuals are reference-only for this HIN.

chunks.title: Mercury DTS / SmartCraft QRG
chunks.text: Physical SmartCraft DTS Quick Reference Guide cover onboard. Binder card: Single Handle ERC Quick Reference 90-8M0208789 (startup, Throttle Only, Helm Transfer, Active Trim profiles, Quick Steer if equipped). Pad label generation (DOCK vs ACTIVE TRIM/QUICK STEER) still needs a close-up photo.

chunks.title: Zipwake trim
chunks.text:
Zipwake Series S confirmed with AUTO PITCH and AUTO ROLL. Factory alternative LENCO is NOT installed.
Interceptors stabilize pitch/roll; engine Active Trim is separate. See Zipwake Series S operator manual.

chunks.title: Water pumps
chunks.text:
Washdown: Flojet R4325143F S/N 22C53625 12V 4.5GPM 12A max 40PSI fuse 15A.
Fresh: Jabsco PAR-MAX 2.9 31395-7008 S/N 22A45914 12V 2.9GPM 5.2A max 40PSI fuse 10A.
Both in battery locker with strainers.

chunks.title: Holding tank
chunks.text:
Polyethylene HOLDING tank confirmed in battery locker; handwritten 80L EF unverified; US list 88L blackwater.
MACER circuit 3P1A on fuse diagram. Toilet brand unverified (Jabsco candidate). Observe NDZ laws.

chunks.title: Bow thruster
chunks.text:
Sleipner/Side-Power bow thruster confirmed at helm. Exact SE40/SE60 model unverified.
Uses dedicated high-current breaker not Blue Sea aux. Short bursts; watch voltage sag.

chunks.title: Windlass
chunks.text:
Electric windlass confirmed with stainless plow/Delta-style anchor on bow roller.
Quick HRC multipurpose control panel manual CE REV 005c onboard (exact HRC SKU TBD).
Blue Sea 187-Series 80 A windlass breaker CONFIRMED. Winch motor brand/model and chain size still unverified (Lewmar PDF is alternate winch candidate only).

chunks.title: How deep can I anchor (scope / rode)
chunks.text: Rode length on HIN BEYFT208F223 is UNVERIFIED — no boat-specific max anchoring depth yet. Hull draft is 0.50–0.90 m (not rode length). Use scope ~5:1 calm / 7:1+ in wind against measured rode: max depth ≈ rode÷scope − bow height. Garmin depth is water under transducer, not rode remaining. Measure chain+rope length to answer precisely. See chapters/10-ground-tackle.md.

chunks.title: Teak deck
chunks.text:
Owner confirmed real teak on cockpit and swim platforms — factory solid wood/teck option class.
Not synthetic SeaDek/Flexiteek. Rinse salt; care differs from foam decking.

chunks.title: T-Top and ski
chunks.text:
Black T-Top with fabric roof and 4 aft rod holders confirmed. Black pulpits confirmed.
Stainless ski/tow pylon U-arch over engine confirmed. Elegance grey/cognac upholstery. Cockpit table present.

chunks.title: Symptom to fuse hints
chunks.text:
Quick fuse hints: stereo→AN4 10A; Garmin→HDS 5A; fresh pump→1P2B/10A; washdown→Flojet 15A;
macerator→3P1A; bilge→4P1A; fridge→1C1A; fixed VHF→not installed.

chunks.title: Ruled out equipment
chunks.text:
NOT INSTALLED on this vessel: LENCO trim tabs (Zipwake instead); Mastervolt charger (CRISTEC instead);
fixed VHF radio (handheld only; Blue Sea VHF fuse is spare/pre-wire).

chunks.title: Stock vs options
chunks.text:
Reads as US Trim Package + electronics/sound + Zipwake + thruster + deck wash + T-Top/ski + teak + Verado 300.
Clear later-added: SAN DIEGO CA seat lettering. Need dealer build sheet for HIN for 100% proof.

chunks.title: Safety limits
chunks.text:
Max 10 persons / 1285 kg. Always use kill lanyard. Do not bypass 30mA shore RCD.
Handheld VHF only for radio. Real teak slippery when wet. EPHS fluid loss reduces steering assist.
